version_1.hook: 路过成都·建设路这家烧烤店，门面不起眼，但我劝你别错过。
version_1.body: 一进去先点羊肉串、烤茄子、蒜蓉生蚝，人均大概75元。老板家的卖点很实在：炭火现烤不蘸料也香，夜宵常备座位。吃完你会明白，为什么附近人总往这儿钻。
version_1.cta: 就在附近的朋友，导航搜「老王烧烤」，今天就来尝尝！

version_1.video_prompt_sample: Image-to-video, vertical 9:16, photorealistic talking-head digital human. Subject: East Asian man around 30, neat short hair, friendly smile, clear features, wearing dark casual button-up shirt, simple, no logos. Scene: restaurant interior, warm lighting, softly blurred table with dishes in background. Subtle hint of signature dish (羊肉串) on the table behind. Camera: medium close-up chest-up, slight three-quarter angle, handheld phone vertical framing, locked framing, mild natural head motion. Action: speaking to camera with natural hand gestures, confident and warm. Expression: engaging, sincere, slight smile while talking. Lip-sync: accurately mouth the Chinese line: "路过成都·建设路这家烧烤店，门面不起眼，但我劝你别错过。一进去先点羊肉串、烤茄子、蒜蓉生蚝，人均大概75元。". Audio: clear Mandarin voiceover matching the lip motion. Lighting: warm restaurant practical lights, soft key, no flicker. Quality: sharp face, natural skin, no warping, no subtitle burn-in. Brand context: promo for 老王烧烤. Segment 1.
